text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
අති විෙශෂ
No. 2381/52 – SATURDAY, APRIL 27, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
,, Notice under Section 7

My Ref No.: MAT/LND/LA/4/1587. I, hereby give notice under Sub - section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/ Servitude which are required for public purpose :
Description of land or servitude to be acquired:

The allotment of Land in total extent of 0.1398 Hectare as Lot No. 1 and 2 depicted in the Cadastral Map No. 530518 and dated 19th December 2023 prepared by the Surveyor—General situated in the village of Matugama, in the Divisional Secretary’s Matugama in the District of Kalutara—in Western Province morefully described as follows:
01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Horahenkele, Shantha Jorge state; Description: Road; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Land Reform Commission; Extent: 0.0203 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Horahenkele, Shantha Jorge state; Description: Garden; Water tank and permanent building; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Land Reform Commission; Extent: 0.1195 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/ lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Mathugama on the 02nd day of September 2024 at 2.00 p.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 26th day of August 2024 the nature of their interests in the land. The particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/ servitude , the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
L. K. Mൺൽඎඌඁൺ Sඁൺඇ඄ൺඅඉൺ, Divisional Secretary, Matugama.
Divisional Secretary’s office Matugama, 16th April 2024. EOG 04-0226
